stemMd: In a race with no ties, Lea finishes ahead of Mo but behind Nia. Omi finishes ahead of Nia. Among these four runners, who finishes second?
explanationMd: Combining the relations gives Omi, Nia, Lea, Mo. Nia is therefore second among these four runners.

distractorRationale.b: The comparisons determine a complete order.
